fields.ndvi: MODIS Terra monthly NDVI (0 = bare, 1 = dense green)
fields.lst_c: MODIS Terra monthly daytime land surface temperature, deg C
fields.*_z: anomaly vs the 2001-2020 normal of that calendar month (z-score)
fields.*_cover: share of the country's land with a valid value that month (clouds and snow leave gaps)

ISL.name: Iceland
ISL.note: NDVI missing in dark, snowy winter months

RUS.name: Russia
RUS.note: European part only, west of 45.0 E

skipped.MCO: too small for the 0.05 deg grid
skipped.VAT: too small for the 0.05 deg grid

modis_landcover_2024.source: MODIS combined IGBP land cover (MCD12Q1) via NASA GIBS, 0.05 deg sampling, water excluded
modis_landcover_2024.note: MODIS calls much Mediterranean woodland 'savanna' (shrub_savanna); CORINE is better where it exists

source: MODIS Terra monthly NDVI (MOD13A3) and daytime land surface temperature (MOD11C3) via NASA GIBS WMS, decoded through the GIBS colormaps (NDVI bins of 0.01, LST bins of 0.6 K), 0.05 deg sampling
